correction_contract.effective_state: replayed deterministically by acash.ppds.transactions; never by a second accounting engine
rejections: conflicting supersessions of the same target
double application of the same correction id
correction of an already-voided event without an explicit re-supersede

accounting_semantics: A correction amends recorded evidence; it is not an executed trade. A mistaken BUY is never represented as a real SELL. Cash and positions are recomputed from the effective event projection, and the original evidence stays readable.
schema_versioning: ACASH_CANONICAL_TRANSACTIONS_V1 is not silently expanded; corrections use a versioned envelope (or a V2 journal contract) decided before implementation, and V1 history stays replayable unchanged.

engineering_status.correction_engine: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — deferred; V1 authoring ships first

rollback: Any status other than RATIFIED disables correction authoring at once; existing journals stay readable under ODR-002 and ODR-005. Reverting the ratifying commit removes the capability.
owner_decision_wording: I authorize ODR_UPI_OWNER_TRANSACTION_CORRECTIONS_006 under APPEND_ONLY_SUPERSEDE_BY_ID: voiding or superseding an already-recorded owner-local transaction event, keeping the original event and its revision lineage, with cash and positions recomputed by the existing PPDS transaction replay. No trading, broker connectivity, capital transfer, market-data retrieval or D5 admission is authorized.
not_authorized_by_this_proposal: In-place rewriting or deletion of historical evidence
